episodes.title: Kapitel ett
episodes.summary: Four years after a traumatic event shook their family, the Sandells seem to be back to normal — until their lives take an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Kapitel två
episodes.summary: During interrogations, the family conceals the truth of what happened that night. Adam uses his position as a pastor to push the case forward.

episodes.title: Kapitel tre
episodes.summary: Stella reflects on a troubling visit and the ensuing discovery at Chris' apartment. Ulrika pulls some strings to start her own investigation.

episodes.title: Kapitel fyra
episodes.summary: Ulrika finds an excuse to set a dinner with friends and validate her suspicions, but she takes a step too far. Stella opens up to her psychologist.

episodes.title: Kapitel fem
episodes.summary: After talking to Amina, Ulrika vows to do whatever it takes to protect her family. Adam unleashes his anger while Stella faces her feelings of guilt.

episodes.title: Kapitel sex
episodes.summary: During the trial, an unexpected witness takes the stand and dramatically upends the Sandell family's world.
